page.overview:
What is Novigrad Morgue?

When Eustace the corpse-collector has a full cart, he drops off the bodies of the dead here, where the important citizens are then inspected and funeral arrangements made. There is said to be an entrance to Novigrad's sewers here.

It is located in the place where Gildorf and Silverton meet.
